name: Wise Crowds
deliverable: Scaled peer advisory council consulting for individual challenge clients

steps.text: Seat one client in front of a circle of advisors and name the challenge they want help with.
Give the client two minutes to describe the situation, what they have tried, and what help they need.
Let advisors ask clarifying questions for two minutes; the client answers but hears no advice yet.
Have advisors discuss and offer ideas to each other for ten minutes while the client listens and takes notes.
Return to the client for three minutes: name what landed, what to discard, and the next step.

failure: Advisors slip into asking the client what to do, the client defends instead of listening, and the circle becomes a normal meeting.
intervention: Turn the conversation back to the circle: "Advisors, talk to each other. Client, write only; your turn to answer comes at the end."
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
